title: Print Your Hacker Banner
description: Write a Python script that displays a cool ASCII banner.
problemStatement:
Create a new file called `banner.py`. Use multiple `print()` statements to output a banner that includes:
- A border made of symbols (e.g., `===`)
- Your hacker alias in large text (you can use an online ASCII text generator if you like)
- A short, inspiring hacking quote or your favorite motto

Example output:
```
====================
   CYBRON AGENT  
====================
"Hack the planet!"
```
Make it unique and personal. This is your signature!
hints: Remember, each `print()` adds a new line automatically.
Use escape characters if you need to print special symbols like backslashes.
You can copy ASCII art from generators like patorjk.com, but keep it simple.
expectedOutput: A multi‑line banner in the terminal containing your alias and a quote.
solutionCode:
# banner.py
print("====================")
print("   CYBRON AGENT  ")
print("====================")
print('"Hack the planet!"')
